# Generated documentation

**Do not edit files in this directory by hand.** They are generated by the docs generator.

## How to generate

From the project root:

```bash
npm run docs:gen
```

This runs `scripts/gen-docs.ts` and (re)writes all generated files deterministically.

## Generated files

| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `conditions-catalog.md` | Table of all conditions (id, label, tags, safety intensity max, nodes) plus per-condition sections with warnings. |
| `preset-schema.json` | JSON Schema (draft-07) for condition profile files under `src/conditions/profiles/<id>.json`. Validates required keys: `id`, `label`, `video_stack`. |
| `preset-schema.md` | Human-readable description of the profile schema and required keys. |

## When to run

- After adding or removing a condition (catalog or profile).
- After changing profile shape or safety fields that should be reflected in the catalog or schema docs.

New or updated `src/conditions/profiles/*.json` and `src/conditions/catalog.json` are read at generation time; new profiles appear in the generated catalog automatically.
